title: Grateful Dead Live at Auditorium Theatre on 1971-10-21

ai_review.summary: Remastered soundboard capture of the Oct‑21 1971 show offers solid audio despite minor flutter, while the performance shines with Jerry’s fiery solos, Keith’s debut organ work and standout renditions of Tennessee Jed, Comes a Time and Me & Bobby McGee.
ai_review.review: The recording is a well‑remastered soundboard source that sounds clear overall, though a few listeners note some wow‑and‑flutter and a slightly off‑balance mix. Musically the concert is high‑energy – Jerry Garcia delivers scorching leads, Keith Godchaux impresses on organ/piano, and the band nails several highlights such as Tennessee Jed, Comes a Time, Me & Bobby McGee and Johnny B. Goode.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers praise the performance and give high marks; recording is generally good with only minor technical quirks, yielding an overall strong rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Remastered soundboard tape sounds clear and balanced for the most part. A few comments mention slight wow‑and‑flutter on Jack Straw, occasional out‑of‑tune guitars and a balance that is a bit off compared to other sources.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Two‑set show with a brisk first set and a short, ~1‑hour second set. The band moves quickly through classics, adds a fresh Keith‑centered organ sound, and keeps the momentum high despite house lights staying on all night.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Multiple reviewers rave about his fiery solos (especially on Me & Bobby McGee) and his biting Strat tone that drives the set.
band_member_comments.Phil: Mentioned as “relentlessly unforgiving,” providing a solid, driving bass foundation throughout.
band_member_comments.Bob: Noted for dueling with Jerry on Big Railroad and adding vocal/guitar flair, including a metal‑yelp on a pre‑Mano Cornuda moment.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith Godchaux’s debut is highlighted as amazing; reviewers admire his ability to cover organ parts formerly handled by Pigpen and praise his youthful virtuosity.
band_member_comments.Drums: Bill Kreutzmann receives brief mention (unforgiving), but no specific drumming commentary was provided.
